Look up the actual definition and it holds up. An energy vampire drains the emotional energy of others, leaving them exhausted and overwhelmed — which is exactly how you feel every time, so the feeling isn't fake.

Here's the part everyone skips over: if someone else decides how drained you feel, that means they have more power over you than you do.

Drama, and needing to be the center of attention. Victim mentality, blaming others for what's going wrong. Constantly needing validation, compliments, reassurance. Criticizing people. Making others feel small. And this is the one nobody sees coming — being charismatic, warm, the "life of the party," is on the list too.

Read that back honestly. Most people watching just found themselves on it at least once.
